constraints.name: horarios_medicos_dia_semana_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((dia_semana)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Sunday'::character varying, 'Monday'::character varying, 'Tuesday'::character varying, 'Wednesday'::character varying, 'Thursday'::character varying, 'Friday'::character varying, 'Saturday'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: usuarios_grupo_sanguineo_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((grupo_sanguineo)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['A+'::character varying, 'A-'::character varying, 'B+'::character varying, 'B-'::character varying, 'AB+'::character varying, 'AB-'::character varying, 'O+'::character varying, 'O-'::character varying])::text[])))
